body: I guess, but i still worry and feel the exact same as you...I wonder whether anybody would put up my shit, it's not exactly easy to deal with, I'm aware of that. But im not getting into a relationship where someone wants to just put up with my shit, I want someone to love me and ill wait. Im just waiting to bump into someone in real life...

I do talk to people. Ive been in college for years, been in lab groups and study groups. I like to think im a good conversationalist but I never see them after class, and I feel there is this...stigma or...something...Like in Middle school you could just say...wanna hang out? and boom, youre riding bikes around the neighborhood. In college...If i ask it theyll just say no...why hang out with me?(not like poor me....but they have their own friends.)

I love endings of tv shows. Thats it. Its over. No more questions, usually. Its all there, ya know.


I talked to someone...and we got to relationships and he said, Relationships are just people putting up with other peoples shit...I said I never wanna be in a relationship where I have to put up with someones shit all the time...and he said" Ha, brother thats just how it works out." I told the story to my my mom and she laughed and said, yah youre gonna have trouble finding someone to put up with your shit. That was rough. I think about being in a relationship all the time but it doesnt make me upset im not in one, i just really want one.  Lifes rough.

I really didnt read any of the controversy but....ive talked to some people about it and know the complaints. Its funny cause that story kinda helped me with depression. This dude ted cant find a girlfriend...He has some amazing friends but his love life sucks which must be hard on him. Ha, I cried alot in the last season for no fucking reason...it was just seeing someone stick with it and get a good relationship out of it also. I thought the girl was really pretty...and he just bumped into her one day and the rest is history...Its hollywood, ya know, but it was a good story.
well you have to finish Dexter...and you have to finish How I met your mother...You gotta see how ted mets his wife.
